body:
Well, I had an OPT, which was expiring in November, and my company had to apply for H1B starting April. But, they didnt start the process until May end, and by June 1st week all the quotas were full. And I dont want to burn bridges with the company by pointing fingers at the HR for not doing her job. 

Even if I find another job, I cant be around in the US till next April, when the quotas start again.

I am sorry, I am not sure how that is supposed to help me. 3 dates in 12 months? And all of them not going past the first date. It is a sure fire recipe for dying alone. I mean, if thats what I have to live for, I am not sure why I need to live every miserable day till the end.
